const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const read = file => fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
const write = (file, content) => fs.writeFileSync(file, content, 'utf8');
const fail = message => { throw new Error(message); };

function replaceOnce(file, before, after, label = before.slice(0, 80)) {
  const source = read(file);
  const first = source.indexOf(before);
  if (first >= 0) {
    if (source.indexOf(before, first + before.length) >= 0) fail(`${file}: trecho duplicado (${label})`);
    write(file, source.slice(0, first) + after + source.slice(first + before.length));
    return;
  }

  const escapeRegex = value => value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
  const lines = before.split('\n');
  const pattern = lines.map((line, index) => {
    const content = escapeRegex(line.trimStart());
    return `${index ? '\\n' : ''}[\\t ]*${content}`;
  }).join('');
  const matches = [...source.matchAll(new RegExp(pattern, 'g'))];
  if (matches.length !== 1) fail(`${file}: padrão flexível encontrou ${matches.length} ocorrências (${label})`);
  const match = matches[0];
  write(file, source.slice(0, match.index) + after + source.slice(match.index + match[0].length));
}

function replaceRegexOnce(file, regex, after, label) {
  const source = read(file);
  const matches = source.match(regex);
  if (!matches) fail(`${file}: padrão não encontrado (${label})`);
  const updated = source.replace(regex, after);
  if (updated === source) fail(`${file}: padrão não alterado (${label})`);
  write(file, updated);
}

function update(file, transform) {
  const source = read(file);
  const updated = transform(source);
  if (updated === source) fail(`${file}: nenhuma alteração aplicada`);
  write(file, updated);
}

function walk(dir, output = []) {
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (['.git', 'node_modules'].includes(entry.name)) continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(full, output);
    else output.push(full);
  }
  return output;
}

// 1) Política de descontos: cupom e desconto por validade não acumulam.
const commerce = 'app-next/src/commerce.js';
replaceOnce(commerce, `export function cartUnitPricing(product, qty, coupon, eligibility, today = new Date()) {
  const original = Number(product.price || 0);
  const couponPrice = eligibility?.eligible ? couponUnitPrice(product, coupon) : original;
  const wholesaleEligible = !product.isFee && Number(qty || 0) >= CONFIG.WHOLESALE_MIN_QTY;
  const expiryBulkEligible = wholesaleEligible && hasExpiryBulkDiscount(product, today);
  const expiryBulkPrice = expiryBulkEligible ? roundMoney(couponPrice * (1 - CONFIG.EXPIRY_BULK_DISCOUNT_RATE)) : couponPrice;
  const effective = wholesaleEligible ? roundMoney(expiryBulkPrice * (1 - CONFIG.WHOLESALE_DISCOUNT_RATE)) : expiryBulkPrice;
  return {
    original,
    couponPrice,
    expiryBulkPrice,
    effective,
    wholesaleEligible,
    expiryBulkEligible,
    couponDiscount: Math.max(0, original - couponPrice),
    expiryBulkDiscount: Math.max(0, couponPrice - expiryBulkPrice),
    wholesaleDiscount: Math.max(0, expiryBulkPrice - effective)
  };
}`, `export function cartUnitPricing(product, qty, coupon, eligibility, today = new Date()) {
